sections.title: Paging and severity
sections.summary: On-call paging for Ledgerly: PagerDuty schedules ledger-primary (Payments Core) and notifier-secondary (Growth), 10-minute ack. Sev1 = transfer error rate over 2% for 5 minutes or any duplicate posting; Sev2 = reconciliation report older than 26 hours or statement render failures over 5%; Sev3 = notifier backlog over 10k. Escalate to the EM after 30 minutes. Covers 'who is on call', 'what is a sev1', 'how to escalate'.

sections.title: Rolling back a bad deploy
sections.summary: Rollback procedure for ledger-api on EKS via Argo CD: kubectl rollout undo deployment/ledger-api in namespace ledger, disable Argo auto-sync with argocd app set --sync-policy none, re-enable once the fix is on main; suspend the reconciler-nightly CronJob during a rollback; database migrations are forward-only and never rolled back by hand. Covers 'how to roll back', 'argocd sync', 'bad deploy'.

sections.title: Duplicate transfers playbook
sections.summary: Playbook for duplicate transfers / double charges (INC-12, 2026-08-30): symptoms are ledger_idempotency_conflicts_total flat while ledger_transfers_created_total spikes and a Redis failover; the X-Idempotency-Key check failed open. Mitigation: IDEMPOTENCY_PG_FALLBACK=1 (default since v2.14.0), find duplicates with the group-by query on transfers, reverse each with ledgerctl transfers reverse (compensating entry, never delete), tell Growth to regenerate statement emails. Covers 'double charge', 'duplicate posting', 'redis failover'.

sections.title: Plaid sync stuck or drifting
sections.summary: Plaid sync stuck or balance drift: reconciliation shows thousands of unmatched rows, reconciler logs ITEM_LOGIN_REQUIRED; the customer must re-auth through Plaid Link update mode (ledgerctl plaid relink), then re-run reconciler --item --window 3; before PR #231 a re-auth reset the transactions/sync cursor and re-imported 30 days, now the cursor is persisted on plaid_items.next_cursor and imports upsert by transaction_id; ledgerctl recon dedupe removes duplicates already imported. Covers 'sync stuck', 'balance drift', 'cursor reset', 'ITEM_LOGIN_REQUIRED'.
